interface: trigger/echo pulse-width on two GPIO lines (not analog); SIM4 firmware uses pulse capture; 5 V from boost converter

measurands.name: distance_mm
measurands.accuracy: resolution 3-5 mm; practical ±10 mm, surface and temperature dependent

corrections.speed_of_sound: c = 331.3 + 0.606 * T_c m/s; pair with a DS18B20 near the air column and correct before computing volumes

failure_modes: no echo: soft/angled target, out of range, or transducer failure; 'no echo' is a status, never a zero distance
readings inside 200 mm blind zone are invalid (transducer ring-down)
warm-air bias: uncorrected reads short by ~1% per 6 degC above calibration temperature
mounting: perpendicular to the target surface; inside tank lids keep the transducer face clear of condensation drips
connector: [PLACEHOLDER: keyed harness part number, must carry two GPIO lines]
